title: Alice's dual input as Bob's reversed input
statement: Fix a positive dimension $n$ and let $\omega$ be a hard-distribution sample. Then Alice's full input vector of the dual sample $\omega^{\vee}$ (obtained by swapping the roles of Alice and Bob and reversing the coordinate order) coincides, coordinate by coordinate, with the reversal of Bob's full input vector of $\omega$; that is, for every coordinate the value Alice receives in the dual is the value Bob receives in the original at the mirror-image coordinate $n-1-i$.
hypotheses_covered: n is a positive natural number
replaced: Alice's full input vector in the dual is Bob's original full vector in reverse order.
